name: mw4
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (MW4, cod26)
note: Phase 2 (2026-11-10): tables walk the 317 working-set zones to their end (C++), 311 recorded zones identical to the emulated game; GrayWolf's Games/MW4 exports models, images, sounds, anims (graywolf-tools docs/games/MW4.md). Exe: Cordycep 2.9.4.0's dump of Call of Duty HQ's cod.exe (PE timestamp 0x6add5b92), flattened (file offset == RVA). Cordycep names the title mw7. Install: Steam's Call of Duty HQ, cod26 folder (plain files, no CASC), the container of Black Ops 7 (IWffa100, header version 25).
install_note: Plain Steam files: cod26\*.ff with their .fp update patches beside, streamed data in cod26\*.xsub and Call of Duty HQ\cod26_shared*.xsub. The working set: every zone not named *_tr, and transient zones sampled per name family. The campaign (sp26, steamapps\Call of Duty\Content\sp26) has its own exe and profile, mw4sp.
args_note: every loader and primitive takes the load context in rcx: file_read(ctx, dst, n), Load_Stream(ctx, bool atStreamStart, dst, n), Load_String(ctx, char **), the context's push(ctx, block) and alloc(ctx, align)
rva_note: DB_ReadXFile(ctx, dst, n); Load_Stream(ctx, atStreamStart, dst, n): reads unless block 11 (memset), the position ctx+0x108 advanced; Load_String(ctx, char **) a byte at a time; alloc/push/pop are the context's methods (vtable 0xc233ac0 +8/+0x10/+0x18). Found from Cordycep 2.9.4.0's CoDMW7Handler.toml patterns and the call graph (C:\tmp\mw4\research\primitives.md); the exe is a clang build

stream.markers_note: draft: phase 2 settles the markers (a pointer & 0x7fffffffffffffff equal to 0x7fffffffffffffff inline, 0x3fffffffffffffff a name-only reference; the asset list's slots -1 or 0x7000000000000000)
stream.stream_objects_note: loadStreamObj (0xd887d60, the callable at +8): the readers' own read, empty in the dump; DB_InitLoadStreams installs {functor vtable 0xc238f98, Load_Stream}
stream.machinery_note: the function object assignment 0x1c19780 and the stream state init 0x21e6500 DB_InitLoadStreams (0x23c7220) calls; Load_AssetType 0x219ea90; Load_AssetHeader 0x2119bd0 (five jump tables and a range tree, its targets in types.json's loaders); the Load_Stream functor class (vtable 0xc238f98: invoke, copy, move, destroy); DB_RewindEnd 0x1da4520 (DB_RegisterStreamOffset inlined in it)
stream.null_page_note: engine lookups the dump leaves empty return null and the loader reads through it (MWIII AllocateUniqueString 0x3d41bd0 skipped; BO7 Load_CustomScriptString 0x3ad7730 falls back to address 8 when the script string map has no entry): a zero page reads as an empty result
stream.global_values_note: aipaths' node reader 0x21252b0 reads 4 more bytes when u32 0xdc62150 != 2 and u8 0xefae745 == 0: both 0 in the dump, which the emulated game reads too
stream.clang_shapes_note: the exe is a clang build: the stack cookie compared inline at a reader's end, an array reader (ctx, flag, count r8, T *r9) testing Load_Stream's result and its count together (0x1c58830)
stream.pure_loops_note: the Ptr functions' name-only arm hashes the name it has just read inline (FNV-1a, lower case, slashes folded: keyvaluepairs 0x2064980), a loop of two back edges the transcriber cannot structure; it reads nothing
stream.read_call_answers_note: Load_CustomScriptString 0x23c7550 looks the 4 bytes up in the zone's script string map (zone+0x18e88, filled at run time, empty here) and raises a fatal error (0x9e82d50, then int3 at 0x23c7614) when they are not there: the emulator reads the 4 bytes and leaves 0 in the slot (map_spawn_points, its first user)

lookup.note: LookupRewindCache(key, u16 [ctx+0xc38], bool mode==0, u32 [ctx+0xc28], [ctx+0xc30], u64 *data, bool *resident, bool *counted): the global cache of data other zones loaded (empty in the dump). Found with resident set, DB_RewindPrepare takes its skip arm: R+0x28 = 0, DB_SkipXFile of the descriptor's skip size, *p = the cached data. A descriptor with skip size 0 (transient zones' xmodelsurfs) has nothing in the file

stream.rewind_prepare_note: DB_RewindPrepare 0x1da40b0, BO7's arms (bit 63 descriptor, bit 60 data, else the rewind key & 0x0fff..., looked up inline in zone+0x18e80); DB_RewindSetData 0x1da4500
stream.rewind_links_note: a DB_RewindPrepare pointer linked layout or not (both walkers): bit 63 past its descriptor, bit 60 here, its key filed unless bit 61; another value the data filed under that key earlier in the zone. equipmentsfx 0x2030eb0 sizes three arrays by u32 0x60 of the struct its 0x1b8 names, a rewind key in global_shared_mp
stream.pointer_ifs_note: the C++ walker links each pointer of its IF chain: one DB_RewindPrepare decides by its top bits (bit 63 past the 8-byte descriptor, bit 60 here, else the rewind table's key, the low 60 bits, of an earlier load; ZoneTableWalker PointerIf kind 3), an asset slot inline (0x7fff...) or by the asset's 63-bit hash (kind 4)
stream.read_calls_note: Load_CustomScriptString(ctx, u32 *) 0x23c7550: 4 bytes read, looked up in the zone's script string map

load_state.note: DBLoadCtx (0xc40), vtable 0xc233ac0; the stream state at 8 (position +0x108, block +0x190), BO7's offsets

stream_init_call.note: DB_InitLoadStreams(ctx, zone) 0x23c7220: the stream state over the zone memory's 16 blocks (0x21e6500), the Load_Stream functor installed in loadStreamObj; the zone memory's fields are BO7's + 0x60

memory_objects.note: the rewind hash (BO7's 0x18e20 + 0x60); bucket count not checked on MW4
the script string map Load_CustomScriptString looks up (BO7's 0x18e28 + 0x60)

asset_type_map.note: GetMappedType: FNV-1a 32 of the type name -> pool id

asset_dispatch.note: Load_Asset(ctx, 0, &entry) 0x211b990: Load_Stream of the 16-byte entry, Load_AssetType, Load_AssetHeader 0x2119bd0

zone_load.note: the XFile loader 0x23c6c70: file_read of the 0x30 list, push(15), DB_LoadStringList, DB_LoadUnkList, pop, push(15), the array alloc(7), Load_Asset per entry (BO7's layout)

lookup_calls_note: 0x219a3b0(type): poolInfo's byte 0x29 of the type (0xc22cc60, 48-byte records), through a singleton
hand_shapes_note: 0x20a0070 (scriptbundle, objectivedata): refused (a rotated loop), its hand table in tables.hand.txt reads its own 0x20 struct
transcriber_budget_note: a reader whose symbolic run passes 200 000 instructions is refused (the table generation once took over 10 minutes on a handful of them)
